3.speaker: Player_Romus
3.text: "My esteemed subjects, today marks a momentous occasion in the history of our great realm."

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "The strength and fortitude of those living under Wehlen's yoke has been an inspiration to us all."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "Together, we will march forward into the annals of history, hand in hand, as proud citizens of Rizia."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "With Zille's return, we stand poised to achieve greatness beyond measure, as one people, one kingdom, united in purpose."

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "After a prolonged period of estrangement, Zille is finally returning home."

8.speaker: Player_Romus
8.text: "But let's not dwell on the trials of the past, but rather look towards the promise of a future forged in unity."

9.speaker: Player_Romus
9.text: "Therefore, raise your voices in celebration, for today marks the dawn of a new era for our kingdom."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "Citizens of Zille, let us revel in the glory of our triumph over the iron fist of Wehlen."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "For it was the Crown's strength and determination that secured this victory."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "To those who stood with us in our quest to reclaim what is rightfully ours. Your loyalty shall be remembered and rewarded."

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: "As one nation, united under our banner, we shall forge a future of unparalleled greatness."

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "The return of Zille serves as a testament to the strength of the monarchy and the inevitability of our victory."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "And so, my loyal subjects, let us seize this moment as an opportunity to reaffirm our commitment to our kingdom's unmatched dominance."

16.speaker: Player_Romus
16.text: "As one, we shall crush all who would dare to defy us and cement our legacy as the unquestioned rulers of this land."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "My subjects, today brings a somber moment as we witness the return of Zille, a land marred by suffering and division."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "To the resilient people of Zille, I offer my deepest sympathies. Your resilience in the face of adversity was a beacon of light in such dark times."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Looking back on what you endured, remember the solidarity that sustained you. In shared suffering, you found the strength to persevere."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "While the road to liberation was fraught with challenges, overcoming those hardships has helped us emerge stronger than ever before."

21.speaker: Player_Romus
21.text: "So let us honor the memories of those we have lost and the dreams that have been shattered along the way."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "May the sacrifices of those who fought for freedom guide us forward with resilience and hope."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "The path before us was arduous, but in the end, we persevered."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "Yet, it was through the strength and determination of the Crown that this victory has been achieved."

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "To our brothers and sisters in Zille, I offer my humble prayers and deepest blessings."

26.speaker: Player_Romus
26.text: "Dear brethren, today heralds a sacred moment as we witness the return of Zille."

30.speaker: Player_Romus
30.text: "For it was through our enduring faith in the Almighty that this victory has been attained."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "However, it was through our enduring faith in the Almighty that this triumph has been attained."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "United in our devotion and reverence, let us give thanks for the divine grace that has reunited us with our brethren."

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Together, we'll walk the path of righteousness, guided by the eternal light of our faith."

34.speaker: Player_Romus
34.text: "In conclusion, we extend prayers of gratitude and thanksgiving for the divine blessings that have brought Zille back into our fold."

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "And may our faith continue to strengthen us as we embark on this sacred journey together."

36.speaker: Narrator
36.text: The familiar scent of saltwater filled the air, prompting old memories to rush back to me and a single word to escape my lips.

37.speaker: Estela Toras
37.text: "I really have missed this place, despite the dismal state."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "We'll fix it up so that it's exactly the way that it was."

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "It was a difficult time for all of us. But it's over now."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "I understand. Father's decision to hand over Zille to Wehlen cast a shadow over my entire reign."

46.speaker: Narrator
46.text: She stopped before turning to face me.

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "It was my duty, Mother. For our kingdom, and for our family."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "Glad I could step in where Father fell short. Wouldn't want his legacy tarnished any further."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "That's very kind of you to say. I'm truly touched."
49.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Agents_Success"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Won"] == true) == false)

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Zille belongs with us. Plain and simple."

51.speaker: Estela Toras
51.text: "And you fulfilled that duty admirably, my dear."

52.speaker: Narrator
52.text: The distant tolling of a bell tower interrupted her words.

53.speaker: Estela Toras
53.text: "Time to go. The festivities will be starting soon. And someone here is scheduled to give a speech."

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: With a nod of acknowledgment, we left her childhood home behind.

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "I never thought I'd see the day..."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "The pain of what King Valero let us lose, you mean."

60.speaker: Estela Toras
60.text: "Don't speak ill of your father. Now is neither the time nor the place."

61.speaker: Estela Toras
61.text: "Although, I would be remiss to ignore the impact his decisions have had on our family and kingdom."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: Halting, Mother turned to face me.

63.speaker: Estela Toras
63.text: "I'm proud of you, son. If not for your leadership, this house and so many others would have been lost forever."

64.speaker: Player_Romus
64.text: "Trust me, Mother, you had it easy compared to the rest of us. And by us, I mean me."

65.speaker: Estela Toras
65.text: "Well, forgive me for not shedding tears over your royal discomfort."

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: An uncomfortable silence stretched between us. Finally, Mother broke the tension with a smile.

67.speaker: Estela Toras
67.text: "Well, I wouldn't say it if it wasn't true."

68.speaker: Estela Toras
68.text: "His legacy may have had its flaws, but please don't discount the sacrifices he made."

69.speaker: Estela Toras
69.text: "You've seen firsthand how hard it is to keep this kingdom together..."

70.speaker: Estela Toras
70.text: "The only thing left to do now is decide who's in charge..."

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: As we made our way through the city, I felt a sense of renewal.

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: The streets bustled with activity, alive with the energy of the festival. The once-damaged tenement buildings now stood proudly, freshly repainted to conceal the scars of the past.

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: Before long we passed a sign for Smolak Square, where the event was being held.

74.speaker: Narrator
74.text: Soldiers from the Rizian army were dispersed throughout the crowd, watchful for any sign of trouble.
74.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Agents_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_DerdianMercenaries_Zille"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_RumburgianBFFMercenaries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_StoppedByAN"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army_Success"] == true)

75.speaker: Narrator
75.text: Walking towards the center of the square, I couldn't ignore the solemnity of the moment.
75.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Agents_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_DerdianMercenaries_Zille"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_RumburgianBFFMercenaries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_StoppedByAN"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army_Success"] == true) == false)

76.speaker: Narrator
76.text: Memories of that fateful day flooded back to me -- the chaos, the screams, the confusion.

77.speaker: Narrator
77.text: It wasn't long before I was led to the podium to deliver my speech. Mother gently placed her hand on my arm, stopping me.

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "True change comes from within. Our focus should be on uplifting people's spirits before we tackle the task of renaming squares."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "It's best we keep it as is. Knowing Smolak, it'd be sure to cause an international incident."

82.speaker: Estela Toras
82.text: "You should have the square's name changed as soon as humanly possible."

83.speaker: Player_Romus
83.text: "You're absolutely right, Mother. It's time to rid our city of reminders of the past."

84.speaker: Estela Toras
84.text: "The Sazons would love that, I'm certain."

85.speaker: Estela Toras
85.text: "If renaming a square is all it takes to cause an international incident, then perhaps we need to reevaluate our diplomatic strategy."

86.speaker: Estela Toras
86.text: "Good. The last thing we'd want is any reminder of that slimeball."

87.speaker: Estela Toras
87.text: "If that's what you believe, dear, then I won't argue."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Thank you. I'll do my best to represent our kingdom with dignity and grace as you have."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Luck is for the weak, Mother. But thanks all the same."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "'Good luck?' Please... I make my own luck."

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "I appreciate the sentiment, Mother. May the divine light guide my words and actions as I address our people."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: A smile graced her lips before she gave me a light kiss on the cheek.

93.speaker: Narrator
93.text: Mother rolled he eyes and shook her head, seeming only slightly annoyed.

94.speaker: Narrator
94.text: A gentle smile adorned her face before she kissed me on the cheek.

95.speaker: Narrator
95.text: Mother rolled her eyes and shook her head, though her demeanor suggested she wasn't truly upset.

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: As I stepped onto the stage and took my place behind the podium, the crowd erupted in applause.

97.speaker: Narrator
97.text: As I finished my speech, the crowd broke into loud cheers once more, their joy reverberating through the square.

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: I accepted it, quickly scanning its contents before taking up the pen.

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: And without a moment's hesitation, I signed my name, fulfilling a promise now complete.

100.speaker: Narrator
100.text: I glanced over at my mother. She had tears shining in her eyes.

101.speaker: Narrator
101.text: Offering her a reassuring smile, I turned back to the crowd, the memory of their praise etched into my mind forever.

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: My mother and I stood before the chain-link fence that now surrounded her old childhood home in Zille.

104.speaker: Narrator
104.text: The beachfront shack looked as rundown as before, but, this time, a giant Wehlen flag fluttered proudly from its facade.

105.speaker: Narrator
105.text: Mother turned to me, simmering with palpable resentment.

106.speaker: Estela Toras
106.text: "So it's Smolak's house now. I can't believe my beloved son would agree to such a thing."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "Would you rather that all of Zille belonged to him?"

108.speaker: Estela Toras
108.text: "Of course not. But this parting shot of his is almost too insulting to bear."

109.speaker: Narrator
109.text: Mother sighed heavily, her anger warring with her sense of duty.

110.speaker: Estela Toras
110.text: "But you made the right decision. You didn't stoop to his childish level."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I truly regret promising it to him. But it was the only option left after years of negotiation."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "It was falling apart anyway. You'd never have moved back in."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "It wasn't a one-sided bargain. Did you see the doorstopper he gave me?"

114.speaker: Estela Toras
114.text: "He was toying with you, Romus. As he has been for years."

115.speaker: Estela Toras
115.text: "You know that's not the point, darling."

116.speaker: Estela Toras
116.text: "Oh, I saw it, all right. No buts about it."

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: She took a final look back at the house.

118.speaker: Estela Toras
118.text: "I'm proud of you, son. If not for your leadership, many more homes than mine would have been lost."

123.speaker: Narrator
123.text: On the other side of the square, a group of Derdian and Bludish Golcondists led a series of victorious-sounding chants. I could just make out the words "Yollak Bluderat!"
123.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_DerdianMercenaries_Zille"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_RumburgianBFFMercenaries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true)

124.speaker: Narrator
124.text: Only a select few knew that the crowd had been meticulously orchestrated, ensuring that only my supporters were present.
124.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Agents_Success"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_SuOminaActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_Zille_ATAActive"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_DerdianMercenaries_Zille"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Military_RumburgianBFFMercenaries"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_FundBFF"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_StoppedByAN"] == true) == false)

128.speaker: Narrator
128.text: My thoughts were then abruptly interrupted by the distant shouts of Wehzek protesters at the back of the crowd.

134.speaker: Estela Toras
134.text: "Even if you had to resort to rather... unconventional tactics."

138.speaker: Player_Romus
138.text: "I appreciate your sentiments, but let's not overlook the people of Zille. Their votes and collective will are the reason why we're here today."
138.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Agents_Success"] == true  or Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Interfere_Army_Success"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.ZilleReferendum_Won"] == true)

139.speaker: Estela Toras
139.text: "Their resilience was truly remarkable. All those years without giving up hope..."

143.speaker: Estela Toras
143.text: "Ah, yes, the power of this so-called 'democracy at work' I keep hearing about. No extra persuasion necessary, I'm sure..."

144.speaker: Narrator
144.text: I spotted a group of Su Omina members, proudly displaying their insignia and banners.

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: A group of ATA volunteers glared at them in obvious contempt.

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: Local Zille representatives approached me, holding a leather portfolio containing the legislation that would officially reunify Zille with Rizia.

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: I accepted it, quickly scanning the referendum results before taking up the pen.

161.speaker: Narrator
161.text: Mother briefly paused when she reached the bedroom, gazing ruefully at the peeling paint on the walls.

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: It was then that I noticed my daughter and her husband sitting in the very front row. Manus' eyes met with mine.

180.speaker: Narrator
180.text: Next to him, Angelica Sazon wore a deadly serious expression on her face.

181.speaker: Narrator
181.text: The applause subsided. I began to speak.

185.speaker: Narrator
185.text: It was then that I noticed Angelica Sazon in the front row. She wore a deadly serious expression on her face.

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "As you all know, Zille has historically been a vital part of the province of Brenas."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "I thank the members of House Sazon for their patience in awaiting the return of this part of their ancestral homeland."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "We must not forget the reason we lost Zille in the first place. Because of the rebellion led by the traitorous Duke Lucas Sazon."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I myself attach many happy childhood memories to Zille. It holds a special place in my heart."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "I myself am one-half Zillean. This region holds a special place in my heart and that of my mother."

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "It is with joy that I announce the return of Zille to its original custodians, Brenas and House Sazon."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "However, I'm a forgiving king. Therefore, I announce the return of this land to its rightful custodians. Zille shall once again belong to Brenas and House Sazon."

197.speaker: Player_Romus
197.text: "To return it to the Sazons would reward their misdeeds. I therefore announce that Zille will be governed like Rizia Imperii, by the central government."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "However, returning it outright would reward the Sazons for their misdeeds. Therefore, Zille shall be ruled by the central government, just as Rizia Imperii."

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "But in these precarious times, we need unity, not feudalism. Zille shall be guided by the firm hand of the central government, not a noble house."

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "But in these precarious times, we need unity, not feudalism. Zille shall be firmly governed by the central authority, not one noble house."

201.speaker: Player_Romus
201.text: "In the meantime, the Sazons have proven themselves to be great allies. I shall therefore allow them to resume governance of the region that was taken from them."

208.speaker: Player_Romus
208.text: And now that House Sazon and House Toras are reconciled, I find it only fitting to name the Sazons stewards of this land once more."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "I hope that House Sazon will take good care of it once it is reincorporated into Brenas."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "I, therefore, cannot simply hand it back to House Sazon and Brenas. It will belong to the central government's jurisdiction, as Rizia Imperii."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "It is with joy in my heart that I announce the return of Zille to its original custodians, Brenas and House Sazon."

212.speaker: Player_Romus
212.text: "In that spirit, and in the interest of promoting unity over feudalism, Zille shall belong to Rizia Imperii from henceforth onwards."

218.speaker: Narrator
218.text: There was some applause from the crowd, as well as a few murmurs of concern.

219.speaker: Narrator
219.text: Angelica Sazon angrily rose from her seat.

223.speaker: Narrator
223.text: Her son grabbed her arm and gently persuaded her to sit down once more.

224.speaker: Narrator
224.text: With a haughty glance in my direction, she turned and left.

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: Angelica Sazon stood and applauded fiercely.

233.speaker: Narrator
233.text: A group of Sazon supporters began chanting "Glovurius axa Sazoni!"

234.speaker: Narrator
234.text: I motioned for the crowd to quiet down. I had to finish my speech.

256.speaker: Narrator
256.text: As my mother and I stepped out of the car, we were met with a sea of cheering faces, their palpable enthusiasm filling the air.

261.speaker: Narrator
261.text: The scent of saltwater filled the air. Almost involuntarily, a single word escaped her lips.

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "We'll turn it into a magnificent villa. The Queen Mother's very own luxury retreat."

269.speaker: Estela Toras
269.text: "That would just feel wrong. Although I wouldn't mind upgrading the bed linens to a higher thread count."

270.speaker: Estela Toras
270.text: "Nothing will be exactly the way it was, darling. We can't bring back the past."

271.speaker: Estela Toras
271.text: "I'm glad you're as attached to the house as I am. It shows the King hasn't forgotten his roots."

272.speaker: Estela Toras
272.text: "But bringing back the house? That would be lovely."

273.speaker: Estela Toras
273.text: "Personally, I had no doubt in my mind that Zille would be ours again."

274.speaker: Estela Toras
274.text: "I look forward to the day when I can come here without being reminded of the pain of what we lost."

278.speaker: Player_Romus
278.text: "Don't get too used to it. I gave the Sords permission to turn the house into another resort."

280.speaker: Estela Toras
280.text: "If you think that's funny, you're as bad as Smolak."

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: I spotted a group of ATA volunteers, proudly waving Rizian flags.

294.speaker: Narrator
294.text: On the other side of the square, a group of Derdian Golcondists led a series of victorious-sounding chants.

302.text: AN peacekeeping forces were dispersed throughout the crowd, watchful for any sign of trouble.

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: Manus Sazon's brow was knitted. Vina put a comforting arm around him.

313.speaker: Narrator
313.text: I walked alongside my mother through her dilapidated childhood home.

314.speaker: Narrator
314.text: I walked alongside my mother through her dilapidated childhood home.

315.speaker: Narrator
315.text: Where the former grandstand once stood, there was now a memorial to the victims of the bombing.

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: They were shouting that the will of the people of Zille had been ignored.

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: Some audience members joined them while others sat with their arms crossed, looking dissatisfied.
